Hymn 7: Israel, Israel, God Is Calling
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Charles C. Converse
Lyricist/Text Author: Richard Smyth
Category: Restoration

This is hymn number 7 titled "Israel, Israel, God Is Calling" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Charles C. Converse and the lyrics were written by Richard Smyth.
This hymn is categorized under: Restoration.
